evidence.quote: We ratified the async job contract

observations.why: Reporting a ratification enacts authority-ranking: a collective with standing approves a binding contract, allocating obligations by rank-based decision rather than reciprocal exchange.

evidence.quote: no lost work if the client drops the receipt

observations.why: Framing the contract's value as protection against proportional loss (lost work as the cost consequence of a client choice) enacts market-pricing: the design is justified by cost-benefit proportionality.

evidence.quote:
the agent either polls the run or
gets the reaction piggybacked on a later call

observations.why: Describing two equivalent reciprocal paths to the same outcome (poll or piggyback) enacts equality-matching: turn-taking alternatives that keep the exchange even, neither party privileged over the other.
